name: BanglaTense: A Large-Scale Dataset of Bangla Sentences Categorized by Tense
description: BanglaTense is a comprehensive NLP classification dataset of 17,819 annotated Bengali sentences categorized across grammatical tenses: 5,629 past tense, 6,101 present tense, and 6,089 future tense. The dataset is designed to facilitate research into syntactic parsing, tense identification, and linguistic analysis in low-resource Bengali NLP.
